schema.description: Agriculture, value added per worker (constant 2010 US$)
Industry, value added per worker (constant 2010 US$)
Services, value added per worker (constant 2010 US$)
Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
Net barter terms of trade index (2000 = 100)
Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$)

yaml:
wdi_economy:
  table: core_tbl
  description: WDI economy indicators for Africa-focused policy analysis.
  dimensions:
    year:
      expr: _.year
      description: Year
    country:
      expr: _.country
      description: Country
    iso3:
      expr: _.iso3
      description: ISO3 code
    region:
      expr: _.region
      description: Region
    subregion:
      expr: _.subregion
      description: Subregion
    income_group:
      expr: _.income_group
      description: World Bank income group
    is_ldc:
      expr: _.is_ldc
      description: Least-developed country flag
  measures:
    avg_agriculture_va:
      expr: "_.agriculture_va.mean()"
      description: Agriculture value added (% of GDP)
    avg_industry_va:
      expr: "_.industry_va.mean()"
      description: Industry value added (% of GDP)
    avg_manufacturing_va:
      expr: "_.manufacturing_va.mean()"
      description: Manufacturing value added (% of GDP)
    avg_services_va:
      expr: "_.services_va.mean()"
      description: Services value added (% of GDP)
    avg_output_per_worker:
      expr: "_.output_per_worker.mean()"
      description: Output per worker (constant 2011 PPP $)
    avg_agr_va_per_worker:
      expr: "_.agriculture_va_per_worker.mean()"
      description: Agriculture VA per worker (constant 2010 US$)
    avg_ind_va_per_worker:
      expr: "_.industry_va_per_worker.mean()"
      description: Industry VA per worker (constant 2010 US$)
    avg_srv_va_per_worker:
      expr: "_.services_va_per_worker.mean()"
      description: Services VA per worker (constant 2010 US$)
    avg_unemployment:
      expr: "_.unemployment_rate.mean()"
      description: Unemployment rate (% of labour force)
    avg_investment:
      expr: "_.investment_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Gross capital formation (% of GDP)
    avg_savings:
      expr: "_.savings_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Gross savings (% of GDP)
    financing_gap:
      expr: "_.investment_pct_gdp.mean() - _.savings_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Financing gap (investment less savings, % of GDP)
    avg_fdi:
      expr: "_.fdi_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: FDI net inflows (% of GDP)
    avg_remittances:
      expr: "_.remittances_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Personal remittances (% of GDP)
    avg_current_account:
      expr: "_.current_account_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Current account balance (% of GDP)
    avg_terms_of_trade:
      expr: "_.terms_of_trade_idx.mean()"
      description: Net barter terms of trade (2000 = 100)
    avg_exports:
      expr: "_.exports_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Exports (% of GDP)
    avg_imports:
      expr: "_.imports_pct_gdp.mean()"
      description: Imports (% of GDP)
    total_gdp:
      expr: "_.gdp_current_usd.sum()"
      description: Total GDP (current US$)
    avg_gni_per_capita:
      expr: "_.gni_per_capita.mean()"
      description: Avg GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$)
    total_population:
      expr: "_.population.sum()"
      description: Total population
    country_count:
      expr: "_.iso3.nunique()"
      description: Number of distinct countries

queries.label: The lopsided shift
queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t1"."year",
    AVG("t1"."agriculture_va") AS "avg_agriculture_va",
    AVG("t1"."industry_va") AS "avg_industry_va",
    AVG("t1"."manufacturing_va") AS "avg_manufacturing_va",
    AVG("t1"."services_va") AS "avg_services_va"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM "core" AS "t0"
    WHERE
      "t0"."region" = 'Africa'
  ) AS "t1"
  GROUP BY
    1
) AS "t2"
ORDER BY
  "t2"."year" ASC

      "t0"."region" = 'Africa'
